description: Fixed five-symbol historical research snapshot selected for coverage and documented adjustment lineage before examining forecast metrics.

notes: The archive bootstrap calls yfinance.Ticker.history(period='max', auto_adjust=False, actions=True). It preserves distinct Close and Adj Close columns plus split and dividend events. The README describes Adj Close as adjusted for splits and dividends.

Raw Open/High/Low/Close share Yahoo's split-adjusted price basis and exclude dividend adjustment. The loader must multiply raw OHLC by Adj Close / Close to obtain a common split-and-dividend-adjusted basis; use adjusted closes for targets. This is an adjusted-return research target, not a prediction of a future nominal cash price.

The archive is a third-party Yahoo Finance snapshot, not independently verified official exchange data. Yahoo, Kaggle and NSE direct requests were blocked by the cloud egress proxy with HTTP 403; normal TLS-verified GitHub downloads succeeded.

Each symbol has 2713 rows within the predeclared 2010-01-01 through 2020-12-31 study window; the original checksum-pinned files include older and later history. Crop to this window before feature construction. Zero-volume placeholders on 2014-04-24 and 2014-10-15 must be excluded uniformly before computing trading-session horizons. Positive-volume Muhurat weekend sessions on 2019-10-27 and 2020-11-14 must be retained. Exclusions depend on traded volume, not price outcomes.
TCS has questionable pre-IPO observations in the full vendor history. The predeclared common study starts in 2010 for every symbol; no pre-2010 rows enter features or labels.

Archive daily updates merge only five recent sessions and may leave older adjustments stale after later corporate actions. The fixed study ends in 2020, before the incremental-update boundary; do not assume that later archive periods are uniformly adjusted without a fresh audit.

The five symbols are the existing application universe, not a historical index-constituent sample. Results have survivorship and universe-selection limitations and do not generalize to all NSE equities.
Raw Parquet files are cached under ignored .runtime paths. Do not commit or redistribute the data or use archive-derived models in commercial deployments without the required source rights.
